subject: science
description: Apply Mendel's laws, solve Punnett squares for monohybrid and dihybrid crosses, understand DNA base pairing and Chargaff's rules, and distinguish analogous from homologous structures.
learningObjectives: Solve monohybrid and dihybrid Punnett squares and predict offspring ratios
Identify patterns of inheritance including incomplete dominance and codominance
Apply Chargaff's rules to calculate DNA base proportions
Distinguish analogous and homologous structures as evidence for evolution
